Definition: properly, a distinguished thing; hence something valuable, as a product or fruit
KeyPassages: Deuteronomy 33:13; Deuteronomy 33:14; Song of Solomon 4:13; Song of Solomon 7:13
BiblicalUsage: Precious things are the best fruits of the land, and Moses blesses Joseph with the precious things of heaven and earth, the dew and the deep, the sun and the moon. The Song pictures the garden as an orchard of precious fruits, and the mandrakes give their smell at the gates.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the precious things are God's way of blessing the whole of life: heaven and earth, sun and moon, garden and field — and the blessing of Joseph is the picture of a life God fills from top to bottom. The mandrakes at the gates are the small sign of it: even the road home smells of the garden.
RelatedPeople: Moses; Joseph, Son of Jacob; King Solomon
